newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's July producer price index dips 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's July producer price index dips 0.4 pct.

text.p: Colombia's producer price index (PPI) dipped 0.4 percent in July compared with June, the central bank said in a statement Friday.
The index is now running at 11.7 percent in the year so far and the accumulated figure for the last 12 months is 15.5 percent.
It is the first drop in the PPI since August 1992 when it dipped 0.07 percent, according to the central bank. The PPI grew 2.1 percent last month.
The July fall was aided by a 13.59 percent drop in the domestic price of coffee, a 1.2 percent decline in the cost of cattle and a 6.9 percent fall in the price of pulses.
The decline in the index was offset by a 4.2 percent rise in the cost of vegetable, a 6.3 percent increase in the price of potatoes and a one percent gain the cost of food, drinks and tobacco.
The cost of goods produced and consumed in Colombia fell 0.5 percent in July while the cost of goods produced abroad but consumed in Colombia increased 0.7 percent.
